sourceTextExcerpts.text: When you have departed from me today, then you will find two men by Rachel’s tomb, on the border of Benjamin at Zelzah. They will tell you, ‘The donkeys which you went to look for have been found; and behold, your father has stopped caring about the donkeys and is anxious for you, saying, “What shall I do for my son?”’

wikipediaRead.identityBasisJa: 記事は創世記のヤコブの妻ラケルを扱う。サムエルの節はラケルの墓に言及するだけである。

occurrenceAudit.reasonJa: 個人の登場ではなく、ラケルの墓という場所表現。
